overloadMerges.note: The 3 doc syntax lines are the same overload with progressively more trailing optional params (index, then name), not 3 distinct overloads with an identically-worded semanticRole; collapsed into one overload with index and name both optional.

params.name: vpAreaName
params.description: 4D View Pro area form object name

params.name: index
params.description: Index (0-based) at which to insert the new sheet; values <= 0 insert at the beginning, values exceeding the sheet count insert after the existing sheets

params.name: name
params.description: Name for the new sheet; cannot contain *, :, [, ], ?, \, /

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Inserts a new sheet into the document loaded in vpAreaName, at an optional 0-based index (defaulting to the end) with an optional name.
